sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 50 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% damage reflection for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only).
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 14000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 14000
